scenario: 今日基础设施这一侧，争论集中在训练和服务怎样少占显存、少等计算，又尽量不改答案，也有人把大模型搬到更小的本地设备上。有的把五种常见并行收成同一种广义张量并行，在上万张 GPU 上把万亿参数训练跑到十 EFLOP 每秒量级。有的让空闲推理实例休眠后再把卡借出去，前提是唤醒只要数秒。KV cache 可以无损地从显存压到主机和 SSD，线性递推模型的长上下文并行也把边界开销削下去。推测解码、压缩 MoE 的调度和整数量化，则分别从起草、驻留和计算格式上挤吞吐。文档解析用更小的模型追上更大的通用模型，而稀疏直接求解库则把工程仿真里的分解和回代一并加快。

papers.title: Generalized Tensor Parallelism: Powering Trillion-Parameter LLM Training at 10+ EFLOP/s
papers.authors: Shiqing Fan, Deepak Narayanan, Jimmy Zhang, Jiangfei Duan, Prajwal Singhania, Haoran Zhang, Wanying Wang, Philip Monk, Xuwen Chen, Jared Casper, Jun Yang, Mohammad Shoeybi, Bryan Catanzaro, Vijay Anand Korthikanti
papers.abstract:
Pretraining state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) with up to trillions of parameters is memory- and compute-intensive. Existing parallelization schemes compromise on either per-GPU memory or throughput: data parallelism replicates parameters; tensor parallelism and fully sharded data parallelism (FSDP) add communication of activations and parameters, respectively, to every microbatch; and pipeline parallelism leaves GPUs idle while the pipeline fills and drains.
We show that, for linear layers, five commonly used parallelisms (data, tensor, sequence, context parallelism and FSDP) are special cases of one framework, generalized tensor parallelism (GTP), in which each layer's parameters and activations are partitioned and either can be re-materialized with an all-gather before use.
In GTP, a parameter all-gather is an optional preprocessing step on one input of a matrix multiplication (GEMM), whereas FSDP implementations typically treat it as a step before an entire Transformer block, which can increase memory footprint and delay GEMMs. The GTP view lets us schedule all-gathers per GEMM rather than per block, issuing each early enough to hide its communication but late enough to limit memory.
Our implementation is open source at github.com with it, an internal 2T-parameter mixture-of-experts (MoE) model reaches \textbf{13.0 model EFLOP/s} (exaFLOP/s) on 12,288 GB300 GPUs with 98\% weak-scaling efficiency, and runs with 1M-token sequences on 512 GPUs.
On 256--1,024 GPUs, our implementation achieves \textbf{1.05--1.55$\times$ the throughput of Megatron-FSDP} across three MoE models and \textbf{1.27--1.31$\times$ that of a tuned 3D-parallel recipe with pipeline parallelism} on a DeepSeek-V4-Pro proxy model.
papers.summary: 训练到万亿参数的大模型时，常见并行方案总要在单卡显存和吞吐之间让步。数据并行会复制参数，张量并行和 FSDP 每个微批次都要通信，流水线并行又会让 GPU 在填满和排空时闲着。对线性层来说，这五种常见并行其实都是同一种广义张量并行 GTP 的特例，参数和激活都可以先切分，用时再一次收集回来。它把参数收集当成每次矩阵乘之前的可选预处理，而不是整块 Transformer 前的一步，因而能更早发出通信，又不过早占显存。在 12,288 张 GB300 上，内部两万亿参数的 MoE 模型达到 13.0 EFLOP/s。从 4,096 卡扩到这一规模时，弱扩展效率为 98%。实现已放进 Megatron-Core，还能在五百多张卡上跑长达一百万 token 的序列。

papers.title: ModelLess: A Serverless System for Multi-Tier LLM Inference on Shared GPUs
papers.authors: Ding Shi, Wei Wu, Jiayuan Chen, Chenghu Yang
papers.abstract:
LLM inference platforms sell online, asynchronous, batch and rollout products on GPUs provisioned per product, so a service's cards sit idle between bursts while other work waits. We present ModelLess, a serverless system for LLM inference. Users declare model services and the platform owns the instances. An idle service scales to zero: its instances go to sleep with their weights in host memory (release about 1 s, wake about 4 s for GLM-5.2 at TP8, against a cold start of over four minutes).
Billing follows the time a service holds GPUs. The GPUs that sleeping instances free are lent to lower tiers. Cluster managers preempt low-priority tasks and treat eviction as all-or-nothing, but an LLM instance's eviction cost depends on which of its weights, execution state, KV cache and in-flight requests survive.
ModelLess therefore gives each tier (online, job, flex) eviction semantics that state what it may lose when preempted, and runs a preemption protocol that closes admission before it releases memory, re-enqueues a request durably before it aborts it, and fails closed. Four components (entry, dispatcher, node agent, SGLang plugin) enforce it with sleep/wake, pause/resume of in-flight requests for flex, and a weight-copy path (follow/seal) for RL rollout.
Replaying a week of traces from 1,100 H20 cards serving long-tail online models shows that about 38% of GPU-time (417 equivalent GPUs) could be lent under a coarse latency target with one fixed idle threshold. This is an idealized upper bound, and it holds only if recovery takes seconds: with a 240 s cold start under 8% remains even with per-service thresholds.
On one node, a single four-hour run per policy shows that pausing yields 22% more borrower tokens per held GPU sample than abort-and-requeue, with the same median online latency. The job tier and follow/seal are not yet evaluated end to end.
papers.summary: 大模型推理平台常按产品固定占用 GPU，高峰过去后卡会闲着，别的任务却在等。ModelLess 把推理做成无服务器服务：空闲实例会缩到零，把权重量在主机内存里休眠，释放和唤醒只需数秒，而冷启动往往要四分钟以上。腾出来的 GPU 可以借给更低优先级的档次，并且按在线、任务和弹性各档约定，被抢占时可以丢掉什么。抢占会先停止接新请求，再持久地重新入队，然后才释放内存。回放 1,100 张 H20 上一周长尾在线模型的轨迹，在粗略延迟目标和单一空闲阈值下，约 38% 的 GPU 时间可以出借，这是恢复只需数秒时的理想上限。若冷启动要 240 秒，即便按服务调节阈值，也只剩 8%。

papers.title: LoomKV: Lossless KV Cache Compression from GPU Memory to SSD for LLM Serving
papers.authors: Wentao Zhu, Ziao Sheng, Peng Deng, Huiqi Hu, Xuan Zhou, Xing Wei, Zhuang Wang
papers.abstract:
Large language model (LLM) serving engines offload the key/value (KV) cache from GPU memory to host DRAM and SSD so multi-turn and agent requests can reuse prompt prefixes. Capacity then limits service at two levels: external tiers govern prefix reuse before eviction, while the GPU KV pool bounds concurrent long requests, and lossy compression alters KV values and outputs.
LoomKV brings lossless KV compression to both external tiers (tier mode) and the GPU pool (pool mode) on an unmodified engine. Using a calibrated per-head two-level 3-bit code over BF16 high bytes (sign and upper seven exponent bits), LoomKV stores BF16 KV at 0.71 of its raw size across nine models and FP8 KV at 0.85-0.87.
In tier mode, TileStream writes exact-length records with length readback off the load path, leaving tier storage, eviction, and prefetch unchanged, and decompresses fetched records straight into scattered GPU pages. In pool mode, FragPack packs variable-length records into smaller shared-budget GPU pages read in place by a fused decode-attention kernel faster than FlashAttention-3 on BF16.
Built with LMCache and vLLM, LoomKV makes compressed tiers act as 1.4x larger raw tiers on AgentX: across LMCache's LRU cliff, tier mode delivers 2.7-3.6x raw's goodput and 1.9-3.1x lower mean time-to-first-token (TTFT), shifts the cliff identically under other simulated replacement policies, and cuts repeated-prompt TTFT up to 1.7x via SSD-to-DRAM promotion. When tiers hold the working set, pool mode fits 1.31-1.34x as many GPU tokens, admitting 12 long requests with roughly raw's queue and goodput at 8.
On an AI IDE trace where both tiers and the GPU pool are constrained, tier and pool modes raise goodput by 1.24x and 1.59x. Where raw capacity suffices, compression costs at most 2.2% throughput; tier mode is bit-exact with raw tiers, and pool mode matches FlashAttention-3's numerical accuracy.
papers.summary: 服务引擎把 KV cache 从 GPU 卸到主机内存和 SSD，好让多轮和智能体请求复用前缀，但容量不够就会限制并发，有损压缩又可能改写输出。LoomKV 在不改引擎的前提下做无损压缩，按注意力头校准的两级三比特编码，能把 BF16 的 KV 压到原来体积的 0.71，并在九个模型上得到这一比例。写入分层存储时不必改原有的淘汰和预取，读回时直接解压进分散的 GPU 页。在 AgentX 上，碰到 LMCache 的 LRU 悬崖时，分层模式的有效吞吐是未压缩时的 2.7 到 3.6 倍。若原始容量已经装得下工作集，压缩带来的吞吐损失最多 2.2%，分层模式的输出还与未压缩完全一致。GPU 侧的池化模式则用融合解码内核原地读取更小的页，在工作集已经放下时保持与未压缩接近的排队和有效吞吐。

papers.title: FlashQLA: Efficient Context Parallelism for Gated DeltaNet
papers.authors: Xi Lin, Chengruidong Zhang, Huiqiang Jiang, Xiao Li, Zekun Wang, Junda Feng, Yunfei Mao, Siqi Zhang, Siyu Wang, Man Yuan, Rui Men, Bo Zheng, Dayiheng Liu, Bohan Zhuang, Jianwei Zhang
papers.abstract:
Gated DeltaNet (GDN) achieves linear computational complexity through recurrent state updates, but sequential dependencies between chunks limit parallelism, particularly for long-context workloads with small batch sizes or limited head-level parallelism per GPU. We present FlashQLA, a context-parallel execution framework for GDN that exposes additional sequence-level parallelism while reducing boundary-state preprocessing overhead.
FlashQLA reduces boundary-state preprocessing overhead through decay-aware preparation and extends sequence parallelism across GPUs with Dual CP, which shares summary computation across parallelism levels. Workload-adaptive Auto CP and CP-aware kernel co-design further improve execution efficiency. FlashQLA achieves $1.7\times$-$3.1\times$ forward speedup and up to $4.4\times$ backward speedup over Flash Linear Attention (FLA) on a single GPU.
On eight GPUs with context lengths up to 1M tokens, Dual CP achieves up to $4.8\times$ forward speedup and $4.4\times$ speedup for combined forward and backward execution over FLA KCP.
papers.summary: Gated DeltaNet 靠递推状态把计算做成线性，可块与块之间仍有顺序依赖。长上下文、小批量或单卡头并行不足时，上下文并行往往施展不开，边界状态的预处理尤其昂贵，甚至可占去前向时间的一半以上。FlashQLA 用感知衰减的准备降低这笔开销，并用 Dual CP 在不同并行级别之间共享摘要计算，再按负载自动选择并行配置。单卡上，前向比 Flash Linear Attention 加快 1.7 到 3.1 倍。反向最多加快 4.4 倍。在八张 GPU、上下文长达百万 token 时，Dual CP 的前向最高达到 FLA KCP 的 4.8 倍。自动选择在绝大多数推理和训练负载上都能落到接近最优的配置。真实模型里，多数注意力头的衰减窗口往往短于八千 token，这也让感知衰减的准备更有针对性。

papers.title: Wavefront: Low-Rank Drafting with Parallel Causal Refinement for Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract:
Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by letting a cheap drafter propose tokens that the target model verifies in parallel. Parallel block drafters such as DFlash and P-EAGLE propose a whole block in one forward pass, but they lose the dependence between tokens in the block; DSpark restores part of it with a lightweight correction head that runs sequentially.
Measuring DSpark, we find that this head overrides the base prediction on most slots, so the expensive base readout through the target's full lm_head mostly provides a seed. We therefore propose Wavefront, which follows a simple principle: shrink the base and strengthen the correction head. Wavefront replaces the full lm_head with a learned low-rank base, conditions the correction head on the whole drafted prefix within the same block, and resolves it with a few parallel Jacobi passes.
A fixed pass budget makes the draft step free of data-dependent control flow, so we capture it as a single CUDA graph in vLLM with fused kernels. On Qwen3-8B, Wavefront improves throughput over xPress, DSpark and DFlash by 2.6%, 10.7% and 23.6% on average across math, code, chat and agentic benchmarks, and by 9.6%, 14.3% and 28.9% on SPEED-Bench long-context prompts. On Qwen3.8-27B it leads DFlash2, DSpark and xPress by 7.6%, 10.6% and 5.0%, and by 7.4%, 5.8% and 6.0% on the same long-context prompts.
The gains persist as serving load grows to concurrency 32.
papers.summary: 推测解码让廉价起草器先提出 token，再由目标模型并行验证。并行块起草可以一次提出整块，却会丢掉块内 token 之间的依赖。再用串行修正头补回来时，这个头往往会改写大多数位置，昂贵的完整输出层多半只是在给种子。Wavefront 把完整输出层换成学出来的低秩底座，让修正头看到同一块里已起草的整个前缀，再用几次并行的 Jacobi 迭代解出结果。起草步数固定，因而可以在 vLLM 里收成一张 CUDA 图，并配上融合内核。在 Qwen3-8B 上，它在数学、代码、对话和智能体基准上的平均吞吐比 DFlash 高 23.6%，比 DSpark 高 10.7%。在长上下文提示上，相对 DFlash 的优势达到 28.9%，并发升高后这一优势仍然在。

papers.title: RankServe: Rank-Aware CPU-GPU Scheduling for Memory-Constrained MoE Serving
papers.authors: Hengyi Zhu, Zhendong Mi, Pu Zhao, Yanzhi Wang, Hao Wang, Shaoyi Huang
papers.abstract:
Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale model capacity through sparse expert activation, but their large expert pools impose substantial memory requirements during inference. Low-rank compression reduces the memory footprint of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. However, the heterogeneous expert ranks create unequal storage, transfer, and execution costs. Under limited GPU memory, expert popularity and transfer cost alone cannot determine which experts are most valuable to retain.
We present RankServe, a CPU-GPU serving system for compressed MoE checkpoints with fixed expert ranks. Its key insight is to value GPU residency against the cheaper nonresident path, CPU execution or weight transfer followed by GPU execution, under each expert's rank and token load. RankServe aggregates the resulting estimated savings over routing demand and prioritizes experts by savings per byte.
It updates residency from recent routing history and selects miss paths using current token loads, allowing temporary GPU execution without cache admission. A variable-rank runtime executes heterogeneous factors through grouped matrix multiplications without common-rank padding. Implemented on vLLM, RankServe is evaluated on three MoE models against six serving systems on a single CPU-GPU platform.
Across five batch sizes from 1 to 32, it achieves per-model geometric-mean speedups of $1.69$--$2.29\times$ in time to first token (TTFT) and $1.71$--$2.48\times$ in time per output token (TPOT), relative to the fastest baseline for each configuration and metric.
papers.summary: 低秩压缩能缩小 MoE 的专家池，但不同专家留下的秩不一样，存储、传输和计算代价也不一样。只看热度和搬运成本，并不能决定在显存不够时该把谁留在 GPU 上。RankServe 按每个专家的秩和 token 负载，比较留在 GPU 上，与在 CPU 上算或先搬运再上 GPU，哪条路更便宜，再按每字节节省来排优先级。它根据近期路由更新驻留，未命中时也可按当前负载临时在 GPU 上算，而不写入缓存。可变秩运行时用分组矩阵乘执行不同秩的因子，不必先补齐到同一秩。在单机 CPU-GPU 上对照六套服务系统，各模型几何平均的 TTFT 是每项配置最快基线的 1.69 到 2.29 倍。同一比较里，TPOT 是 1.71 到 2.48 倍。

papers.title: Shifter Quantization: Compact Representations for Native Integer Computation
papers.abstract:
Groupwise quantization is used in LLM quantization to improve accuracy at low bit widths, but grouping weights keeps standard integer MMA from spanning the full dot product for efficient GPU inference. We develop a new quantization method, Shifter Quantization (SQ), that reconstructs native-width integer operands by appending and shifting shared bits. To further extend the efficiency, we develop a special variant of SQ, Shifter Integer (SHI), to use INT4 kernels.
We show that SQ and SHI formats perform better than standard groupwise quantization in quality, as measured by projection error and KL divergence, and in inference speed, as measured during decoding and prefill. For low precision like 2-bit quantization, SQ2 and SHI2 achieve 2.71-3.77x the 4,096-token prefill throughput of llama.cpp on a Q2_K checkpoint and reduce WikiText-2 KL by 6.6-7.8%.
For mid precision like 4-bit quantization, SQ4 achieves 1.43-2.47x the prefill throughput of NInfer's groupwise-integer baselines across the tested models and prompt lengths, with 24-40% lower KL than the NInfer baselines. For high precision like 8-bit quantization, SQ8 achieves 27.4% higher batch-one prefill throughput and 72.7% lower KL than vLLM's online FP8.
papers.summary: 按组量化能在低比特下保住精度，但分组后，标准整数矩阵乘往往无法一次覆盖整个点积，GPU 推理就不容易跑满。Shifter Quantization 通过补上并移位共享比特，重建出原生宽度的整数操作数，其变体 SHI 还能走 INT4 内核。在约四千 token 的预填充上，二比特的 SQ2 和 SHI2 吞吐达到 llama.cpp 中 Q2_K 检查点的 2.71 到 3.77 倍。它们还把 WikiText-2 的 KL 散度降低 6.6% 到 7.8%。质量按投影误差和 KL 衡量，速度则在解码和预填充里一起比较。四比特和八比特设定里，预填充吞吐和误差也优于相应的分组整数和在线 FP8 基线。这样既能保住低比特下的精度，又能让整数矩阵乘覆盖完整的点积，不再被分组把计算割裂开。

papers.title: VenusOCR2.0: Towards Efficient and Effective Document Parsing
papers.authors: Lei Li, Zheng Wei, Yi Yuan, Qingbin Liu, Jiang Bian, Zang Li
papers.abstract:
We present VenusOCR2.0, a compact 1B-parameter vision-language recognizer designed for both high-accuracy and high-throughput document parsing across text, tables, and formulas.
To continuously improve recognition quality without self-training collapse, we build a bounded recursive self-improvement (RSI) data engine where the model acts strictly as a weakness probe, while external multi-expert medoid consensus, VLM visual verification, and factorized synthesis supply reliable supervision across pretraining, curated SFT, and RLVR.
VenusOCR2.0 couples a dynamic-resolution SigLIP2 encoder and 2x2 spatial token merging with a Qwen3-0.6B decoder, adopting compact atomic OTSL tokens to shorten table sequences and reduce structural errors. To further eliminate the autoregressive decoding bottleneck, we introduce PTPv2, a lightweight ($\sim$67M) decoupled parallel draft module that combines frozen multi-layer verifier conditioning, a standalone learned mask, and block-causal all-position next-token prediction.
On OmniDocBenchv1.6, VenusOCR2.0 achieves an overall score of 96.45 and a state-of-the-art 98.57 formula CDM, substantially outperforming massive general-purpose VLMs such as Gemini-3-Pro (92.91) and Qwen3-VL-235B (89.78). Deployed in vLLM on a single H20 GPU, PTPv2 delivers a 2.96x single-request speedup and up to 2.36x higher batched throughput while guaranteeing lossless, token-for-token equivalence with standard autoregressive decoding.
papers.summary: 文档解析既要看清文字、表格和公式，又要跑得快，很大的通用视觉语言模型并不总占上风。新的识别器 VenusOCR2.0 把规模做到约十亿参数，用动态分辨率编码和空间 token 合并，再用紧凑的表格 token 缩短序列，减轻结构错误。为了减轻自回归解码瓶颈，它配上约六千七百万参数的并行起草模块 PTPv2，并保证与标准解码逐 token 一致。训练数据由一套有界的递归数据引擎提供，模型只负责找出弱点，监督则来自外部多专家共识和视觉校验。在 OmniDocBenchv1.6 上，总分达到 96.45，公式 CDM 为 98.57，高于体量更大的 Gemini-3-Pro 的 92.91。部署在单张 H20 和 vLLM 里，PTPv2 把单请求速度提高到 2.96 倍。批量请求的吞吐也有提升，且不会改写标准解码的结果。

papers.title: How to Run NVIDIA Cosmos 3 on Local AI Devices Using Hugging Face Diffusers
papers.abstract:
Running video generation models locally can be challenging when model weights and intermediate data exceed available GPU memory. NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Nano†build.nvidia.com is a world foundation model†www.nvidia.com that generates videos from text, images, and other inputs to support physical AI†www.nvidia.com development. Learn more about NVIDIA Cosmos for physical AI†www.nvidia.com.
This tutorial walks you through how to run Cosmos 3 Nano on a GPU with as little as 12 GB of VRAM by storing most model weights in system RAM and transferring them to the GPU as needed. Using Hugging Face Diffusers, you’ll generate your first video, explore sound and additional input types, and use an FP8 checkpoint to further reduce memory requirements.
This streaming adapter builds on top of the native group offloading†huggingface.co approach from the Hugging Face library to enable generation on a smaller GPU. The tradeoff is that this requires increased system RAM use and PCIe transfers for a smaller GPU-memory requirement. Note that this approach does not provide interactive latency or stream weights directly from disk during inference.
papers.summary: 在本地跑视频生成模型时，权重和中间结果常常超出 GPU 显存。NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Nano 可从文本、图像等输入生成视频，用来支持物理 AI 开发。这篇教程用 Hugging Face Diffusers，把大部分权重量在系统内存，需要时再搬到 GPU，从而在只有 12 GB 显存的消费级卡上也能生成，还可以试声音和其他输入类型。代价是系统内存和 PCIe 传输都会增加，也不能做到交互式延迟，更不会在推理时直接从磁盘读权重。在 RTX 5070 上，720p 文生视频用 BF16 单次跑完要 2,624.9 秒，峰值显存 9.94 GiB。还可以选用 FP8 检查点，进一步降低显存需求。更高显存的卡会更快，但这些测量是单次运行，并不能当成卡与卡之间的正式排名。

papers.title: Accelerating Direct Sparse Solvers for Computational Engineering with NVIDIA cuDSS 1.0
papers.authors: Azi Riahi, Pat Quillen, Kirill Voronin, Lucas Erlandson
papers.abstract:
Sparse linear systems are at the core of nearly every engineering and scientific simulation, from structural mechanics and computational fluid dynamics to circuit simulation and power grid analysis. As problem sizes and complexity grow, and accuracy needs tighten, developers need a direct solver that scales on GPUs without giving up the robustness that production simulations depend on.
The NVIDIA GPU-accelerated cuDSS library is designed to solve large sparse linear systems for engineering and scientific simulations. The general availability of cuDSS†blogs.nvidia.com marked a major milestone, making it a production-ready library that developers and software vendors can confidently deploy in commercial applications.
papers.summary: 结构力学、流体和电路仿真都要解稀疏线性方程组。问题变大、精度变严之后，既要在 GPU 上加速，又不能丢掉生产仿真依赖的稳健性。NVIDIA cuDSS 1.0 成为可商用的 GPU 直接稀疏求解库。在真实的半导体和力学建模矩阵上，相比 Intel MKL，分析阶段的几何平均加速为 2.5 倍，数值分解为 5.9 倍，三角求解为 151 倍。混合内存模式把数据放在 GPU 显存和 CPU 内存之间调度，在大型 VLSI 例子上把最低设备内存需求平均降低约 30%，让过去需要多卡的问题有可能在单卡上解完。它还为对称不定系统提供更稳的选主元，并把符号分解放到 GPU 上加速。厂商可以把这套库直接用到商业仿真软件里。

code_projects.title: erp-agent-harness: An ERP-integrated agent runtime and desktop client built on DeepSeek Harness.
